thread.title: Netflix Stock Stalls Ahead Of Second-Quarter Earnings Report

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Netflix Stock Stalls Ahead Of Second-Quarter Earnings Report

organizations.name: netflix stock stalls ahead of second-quarter earnings report netflix

text:
Netflix stock has more than doubled this year, leaving investors to wonder if it has any gas left in the tank.
X Macquarie analyst Tim Nollen said Thursday that he's sticking with his bullish outlook for Netflix ( NFLX ) despite concerns about valuation after the big run-up.
"It's possible expectations have gotten ahead of themselves into Q2 results but we're not going against NFLX," he said in a report. He reiterated his outperform rating on the stock and raised his price target to 430 from 336.
Netflix shares rose 1.3% to 395.42 The stock hit a record high of 423.21 on June 21 before retreating. Netflix stock is up 106% year to date through Thursday's close.
 Sky-High Expectations The internet television network will report second-quarter financial results after the market close on July 16.
International subscriber adds and price increases for its service could push Netflix estimates higher, Nollen said.
Still, there are big risks for the stock.
"Expectations are sky-high for Q2, so it may take a solid beat to keep the stock momentum going," Nollen said. "Netflix does have a solid history of beating guidance."
Competition is rising, but won't be a huge threat until Walt Disney ( DIS ) launches its rival internet video service in fall 2019, he said.
Netflix currently competes with Amazon ( AMZN ), CBS ( CBS ), HBO, Hulu and others in streaming video. In addition to Disney, Apple ( AAPL ) is planning to enter the over-the-top video market soon.
